dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: This shop is the Inazuma franchise of the Chuyu Trading Company. We mainly sell minerals, jewelry, and jade artifacts.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: We offer the finest minerals from Liyue. Each piece is a gift from Rex Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Although we don't boast the same reputation as those classic brands like The Jade Mystery or Mingxing Jewelry, the quality of our products is definitely on par with theirs!
